subject: pathology
title: Ewing Sarcoma, CD99, t(11;22), and Chondrosarcoma

steps.tx: Ewing sarcoma sheets small round blue cells in diaphyses and flat bones of children, onion skin periosteum, fever and raised inflammatory markers mimicking osteomyelitis dangerously. That round cell tumour is **Ewing sarcoma**. Peak incidence sits in the second decade, and glycogen rich cytoplasm stains PAS positive while the permeative moth eaten pattern on plain films should never be dismissed as infection alone.
steps.say: Diaphyseal onion skin lesion plus fever in a child is Ewing sarcoma mimicking infection; biopsy decides.

vis.alt: Classic X-ray showing diaphyseal permeative lytic lesion with laminated onion-skin periosteal reaction beside CD99 positive small round blue cell histology.
vis.caption: Classic X-ray showing diaphyseal permeative lytic lesion with laminated onion-skin periosteal reaction beside histology of uniform small round blue cells with strong membranous CD99 positivity. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: CD99 membranous staining supports Ewing sarcoma among small round blue cell tumours while molecular EWSR1 fusion convicts, lymphoblastic lymphoma its closest mimic. That membrane marker is **CD99 in Ewing sarcoma**. CD99 also stains lymphoblastic lymphoma and some other round cell tumours, so a positive membrane blush narrows the field without closing the case on its own.
steps.say: CD99 lights Ewing membranes brightly, but fusion testing convicts among round blue mimics.

steps.tx: The t(11;22) translocation fuses EWSR1 to FLI1 transcription factor in most Ewing sarcomas, founding the Ewing family including peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumours. That fusion is **EWSR1-FLI1 from t(11;22) in Ewing sarcoma**. Roughly one case in ten uses EWSR1-ERG from t(21;22) instead, and FISH break apart testing for EWSR1 catches both partners when sequencing is unavailable.
steps.say: t(11;22) EWSR1 FLI1 is Ewing sarcoma's molecular signature in eighty five percent of cases.

steps.tx: Chondrosarcoma cartilages malignant lobules with endochondral ring and arc calcification in pelvis, ribs, and proximal long bones of middle age, surgery its only reliable therapy. That cartilage cancer is **conventional chondrosarcoma**. Endosteal scalloping deeper than two thirds of cortical thickness on imaging favours this malignancy over a quiet enchondroma, especially when new pain appears in a previously silent lesion.
steps.say: Rings and arcs calcification in a pelvic cartilage tumour of middle age means chondrosarcoma; cut it widely.

vis.caption: Chondrosarcoma radiographic features with chondroid calcification.

steps.tx: Grading chondrosarcoma by cellularity, nuclear size, and mitoses predicts metastasis, grade one now atypical cartilaginous tumour in limbs behaving locally. That grade language is **chondrosarcoma grading and ACT terminology**. Grade 2 and grade 3 tumours metastasise to lung in a substantial minority, whereas grade 1 lesions in the limbs rarely spread beyond their local compartment.
steps.say: Grade writes chondrosarcoma prognosis; grade one limb lesions earn the kinder ACT name.

steps.tx: Dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma juxtaposes low grade cartilage with high grade sarcoma abruptly, prognosis collapsing to the dedifferentiated component's tempo. That biphasic danger is **dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma**. A biopsy sampling only the bland cartilage half badly understages the patient, so radiology must guide the needle toward the noncartilaginous, lytic focus before treatment is planned.
steps.say: One slide kind, next slide savage: dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma follows its worst component's clock.

nodes.label: Round cell or cartilage tumour suspected
Centre planned biopsy with molecular tests

steps.tx: Ewing chemotherapy responsiveness contrasts chondrosarcoma resistance, making molecular diagnosis therapeutic destiny among bone sarcomas rather than academic label. That divergence is **entity based therapy in bone sarcomas**. Interval compressed vincristine, doxorubicin and cyclophosphamide alternating with ifosfamide and etoposide lifts Ewing survival, while the same drugs add toxicity without gain in conventional chondrosarcoma.
steps.say: Ewing melts with chemotherapy, chondrosarcoma ignores it; naming the entity prescribes the strategy.

steps.tx: Bone tumour staging Enneking blends grade, compartment, and metastasis into surgical margins language shared between radiologist pathologist surgeon. That shared system is **Enneking staging of musculoskeletal tumours**. Stage IIB means high grade, extracompartmental and nonmetastatic, a combination that pushes the surgeon toward the widest planned margin or amputation discussion.
steps.say: Grade, compartment, metastasis: Enneking lets every sarcoma specialist speak one margin language.
